name: DIASENSE
description: DIASENSE develops quantum diamond magnetic microscopes based on nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers for contactless semiconductor chip failure analysis and defect detection. The Lyngby-based DTU spin-out joined the BioInnovation Institute (BII) Venture House 8 cohort and secured EUR 1.3M in follow-on BII funding in March 2026, bringing total funding to approximately EUR 1.8M. Its quantum diamond microscopy targets a chip-yield bottleneck where conventional methods cannot non-invasively map current flow inside packaged integrated circuits.
